eyebrow.zh: 完成即推送 · 失控即提醒 · 守住额度
eyebrow.en: Pings on done · Alerts on loop · Saves your cap

headline.zh:
agent 一完成就推给你,
失控循环烧掉额度前,先提醒你
headline.en:
The instant your agent finishes, it pings you
Before a runaway loop burns your cap, it warns you

sub.zh: 它在浏览器里守着你那些跑很久的 agent,一完成、或开始重复打转,就把信号推到你真正在用的 IM;跑过你设的时限,还会再提醒你一次。
sub.en: It keeps watch over your long-running agent from inside the browser, and the instant it finishes — or starts repeating itself in a loop — pushes the signal to the IM you actually live in, pinging you again if a run drags past the limit you set.

title.en: The second it ends, the message lands

body.zh: 跑很久的 agent 终于结束时,一条消息带着耗时和简短摘要直接落到你的 IM——不用再开着标签页来回刷,也不会错过它完成的那一刻。
body.en: When a long run finally finishes, a message with the time it took and a short summary drops straight into your IM — no more propping a tab open and refreshing, and no missing the moment it's done.

title.en: It starts looping — you hear it first

body.zh: 当同一段话在多轮之间反复出现、agent 像在原地打转,一条提醒先于额度被烧光到你手里——还带你回到那个标签页,停不停由你决定。
body.en: When the same reply starts repeating across turns and the agent looks stuck in a circle, a warning reaches you before the cap gets burned down — with a link back to that tab, so you decide whether to stop it.

title.en: Run too long, and it speaks up

body.zh: 有些任务会一直跑下去不收尾。你设一个时限,只要浏览器还开着,一旦超过就有一条提醒到你 IM——不用一直盯着,也不会一回神才发现整周额度早被烧光。
body.en: Some runs just keep going without ending. Set a limit, and as long as your browser stays open, the moment a run crosses it a reminder hits your IM — no need to keep watching, so you don't come back to find the week's allowance already burned through.

title.zh: 推到你真正在用的 IM
title.en: Pushed to the IM you actually live in

body.zh: 信号直达微信、钉钉、飞书——你不用再为收个通知去装新 App 或守着电脑。整个东西跑在你自己的浏览器里,没有后端;黏贴一个 webhook 地址,发条测试消息就知道通了。
body.en: Signals land in WeChat, DingTalk and Feishu — no new app to install, no sitting at the computer. The whole thing runs inside your own browser with no backend; paste a webhook address, send a test message, and you know it's wired up.

chips: › 微信 / 钉钉 / 飞书
› 无后端 · 浏览器内运行

headline.zh: 让整夜狂转的 agent,不再烧光你的额度
headline.en: Stop an overnight loop from burning your cap

sub.zh: 开源、MIT,加载进浏览器即用——黏贴一个推送地址,发条测试消息,下一次 agent 完成时你就会在 IM 里看到它。
sub.en: Open source, MIT, ready the moment you load it into your browser — paste a push address, send a test message, and the next time your agent finishes you'll see it in your IM.

tag.zh: 开源 · MIT · 浏览器里的 agent 信号灯塔
tag.en: Open source · MIT · the in-browser beacon for your agent runs
